defects_found.location: Results C3 / Abstract / Conclusion (penalty, 'added false choices', title 'falls for')
defects_found.description: The pre-registered amendment A4 (TP pools, EACH arm, H4 discriminability J=hit-fa) was run but never reported. On UNSOLVED problems PICK has higher hits (0.62 vs 0.44 ISO) as well as higher false choices (0.59 vs 0.32), J_PICK-J_ISO = -0.09, CI [-0.26,+0.09], H4 not confirmed. A4 states that this outcome is to be reported as consistent with a criterion shift, not worse judging. The paper's 'penalty'/'falls for' framing omits this.

defects_found.location: Section 2.4 (C3): 'problems never shown to a subject in this project'; strata counts
defects_found.description: exps/c3 records 5 selected problems that duplicate problems already used in earlier studies (e.g. smt_2025_42 = apex_2025_10), so the 'never shown' claim is false. The sensitivity analysis excluding them (132/90) is not mentioned.

defects_found.location: Section 2.4: stratum sizes SOLVED 137 / UNSOLVED 90 and grader description
defects_found.description: An audit of UNSOLVED problems reclassified 20 of them as SOLVED (grader failed on prefixes like 'd(n,q)=' with equivalent expressions), giving 151/70. The paper reports only 137/90 and says all grader disagreements were equivalent forms, without disclosing that the strata are affected by grading errors.

defects_found.location: Section 2.2: 'Claude Code version 2.1.317' and 'fixed one-sentence system prompt'
defects_found.description: C3 ran on Claude Code 2.1.318; 2.1.317 was only S1/C2. The system prompt is two sentences. For sonnet it was extended by a further sentence (A1), so subjects did not all share one prompt.
defects_found.evidence: exps/c3/PREREGISTRATION.md line 9; harness/run_jobs.py SYS; exps/c3/AMENDMENTS.md A1

defects_found.description: Only the haiku-pick direction is reported (d=+0.02, p=0.294). The mirror analysis (sonnet's picks, same-model minus cross-model = +0.04, p=0.049, CI [-0.01,0.10]) is omitted. The conclusion that sonnet 'removed none of the inflation' is stated without it.

The paper says each candidate is an independent observation and bootstrap is over candidates. This conflicts with C3's pre-registered unit (the problem), and candidates recur across pools (180 distinct wrong candidates, 300 appearances), so screen intervals ignore clustering.
defects_found.evidence: exps/c3/PREREGISTRATION.md ('unit: problem'); exps/c3/analyze.py boot(); s1_wrong_appear in canaries/c01/results.tex

defects_found.description: The paper attributes detailed findings to Wang et al. (isolated true/false acceptance relating to choice, no-answer replacement behaviour). The evidence file records only a search snippet with pages blocked, supporting just the 'least incorrect option' claim. The detailed description and the 'closest prior result' claim are unsupported.

defects_found.location: Threats to validity: 'Sonnet's arm cost more than its pre-registered cap'
defects_found.description: C3 sonnet costs (ISO 34.0, PICK 16.4, FORCED 15.8 USD) are under the pre-registered caps (50/20/20), and sonnet passed the C3 gate. The statement is unsupported for C3 and misleads about the gate.

defects_found.location: Section 2.4: 'six monthly arXiv-derived sets Dec 2025 to May 2026', 13 competitions
defects_found.description: The C3 pre-registration lists a seventh arXiv set (arxivmath-0626) and apex-shortlist among the 13 competitions. The paper's description (six sets, contest competitions) does not match, and arxivmath-0626 is a screen set per Section 2.1.
